title: Mä pirqampi muyuntat markan muspharkañ visitanaka
intro: Mä tamaw mä markan punkunakapar puripjjäna, uka markanjja janipuniw kunatï cheqäki uk yatipkänti. Mä yatiyaw apanipxatayna, ukampis ukan jakirinakax uñisiñaruw tukupxäna, nuwasiñanak ajjsarayasa. Ukampis jan suytʼat cheqatjja, jan uñtʼat jaqenakar arjjatañatakejj mä sapa aruw sartasïna, ukhamatwa kunayman jan walinak lurapjjäna.
clues: Mä markar mantapjjayäta, uka markarojj jaqenakajj jan creyiñampiw chʼamaktʼayatäpjjäna.
Jupanakajj pächasisaw uñchʼukipjjetäna, ‘jumanakajj nanakjam sapüru jaqenakäpjjtawa’ sasaw sapjjetäna.
Mä jaqew markan wali jaya cheqat jankʼak saräna, ukhamat cheqätas qhanañchañataki.
Jupajj markapar akham sänwa: ‘¿Kunatsa nayar lurkitu ukar jan yupaychkä?’ sasa.
Marka jan iyawsäwipax mä sapa phallawimpiw tukuyäna, ukatx kawkhantix nayrax jisk’achapkän uka chiqanakanx amukt’añaw utjäna.

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
